abilities.name: Sparkling Scatter
_curatorNotes: Multi-variant normal attack: Ningguang has 3 animation variants — Left, Right, Twirl — selected quasi-randomly based on prevAttack state. All variants deal the same multiplier (attack[]). hits[0].frames uses the Left variant (initial prevAttack state, most common in NC chain openers). Right variant frames: {swap:5, C:40}. Twirl variant frames: {swap:13, C:40}. Reviewer to decide representation — single entry with note, or variant entries keyed by preceding N type.

Multi-variant charge attack: chargeFrames records the Left variant (used after Left/Twirl normals when entering from NormalAttackState). Right variant (after Right normal): {swap:67, N:68, E:72, Q:69, D:54, J:54}. Twirl variant (from random/non-normal state): {swap:76, N:76, E:77, Q:77, D:61, J:62}. Raw base values recorded (windup=0). At runtime gcsim subtracts 15 frames when entering from NormalAttackState or ChargeAttackState — reviewer to decide whether post-windup values should be used instead.
No plunge.go in gcsim character dir — plungeFrames not available.

abilities.name: Jade Screen
abilities.description:
Ningguang creates a Jade Screen out of gold, obsidian, and her great opulence, dealing AoE Geo DMG.

Jade Screen
·Blocks opponents' projectiles.
·Endurance scales based on Ningguang's Max HP.

Jade Screen is considered a Geo Construct and can be used to block certain attacks, but cannot be climbed. Only one Jade Screen may exist at any one time.
_curatorNotes: Jade Screen construct spawns at frame 0 (Constructs.New called directly, not in a task queue). Damage hitmark is at skillHitmark=17. C2 (Shock Effect) resets skill CD when the screen is destroyed (6s ICD), including when destroyed by Starshatter (Q).

Burst (Starshatter) also destroys the active Jade Screen via c.Core.Constructs.Destroy(c.lastScreen) and fires additional gem projectiles. The terminatesOn field records only 'recast' (new E cast); reviewer to decide if 'onBurst' also warrants representation.

abilities.name: Starshatter
abilities.description:
Gathering a great number of gems, Ningguang scatters them all at once, sending homing projectiles at her opponents that deal massive Geo DMG.
If Starshatter is cast when a Jade Screen is nearby, the Jade Screen will fire additional gem projectiles at the same time.

passives.name: Backup Plan
passives.description: When Ningguang is in possession of Star Jades, her Charged Attack does not consume Stamina.

passives.name: Strategic Reserve
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual trigger. Likely onDash for the active character, firing only when a Ningguang Jade Screen construct is on-field (gcsim checks CountByType(GeoConstructNingSkill) > 0). Target: active character (not team — only the dashing character gets the buff). Duration 10s (600 frames). Stat: geoDmgBonus +12%. Source: asc.go subscribes to event.OnDash.
passives.description: A character that passes through the Jade Screen will gain a 12% Geo DMG Bonus for 10s.
